title: Built-in flash
summary: Make the pop-up flash look less harsh.

items: **Flash compensation** changes only the flash power. Available in P, Av, Tv and M.
**Diffuse:** hold or tape tissue paper over the flash to soften it.
**Bounce:** angle a small white card at 45° in front of the flash to throw light at the ceiling.
**Fill flash in daylight** lifts shadows on faces and slightly darkens the background.

blocks.text: The built-in flash runs off the camera battery, so it's weak and only reaches a few metres.
